# slack_user_ids (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "slack_user_ids" "this" {
  usernames = ["u1", "u2"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `usernames` (Set of String) Set of usernames to get userids for.

### Read-Only

- `last_updated` (String)
- `slack_ids` (Map of String) The map of usernames and userids
